description: Candidate port of nera-data-layer legacy_execution_surfaces at 2b1504adc4291daaf080b2e932962b134da1a69a.

stages.name: paths
stages.query:
SELECT DISTINCT __path,CASE WHEN substr(__path,1,4)='api/' THEN substr(__path,5) ELSE __path END AS path FROM (
 SELECT __path FROM fns UNION SELECT __path FROM ident_calls UNION SELECT __path FROM attr_calls UNION SELECT __path FROM from_imports UNION SELECT __path FROM direct_imports)

stages.name: calls
stages.query:
SELECT __path,__start,__end,__start||':'||__end AS id,'identifier' AS callee_kind,callee,callee AS full_callee,NULL AS object_text FROM ident_calls
 UNION ALL SELECT __path,__start,__end,__start||':'||__end,'attribute',callee,full_callee,object_text FROM attr_calls
 UNION ALL SELECT __path,__start,__end,__start||':'||__end,'other',full_callee,full_callee,NULL FROM other_calls

stages.name: function_symbols
stages.query:
SELECT f.__path,f.__start AS id,f.__start,f.__end,f.name,coalesce((SELECT group_concat(name,'.')||'.' FROM (SELECT c.name FROM classes c WHERE c.__path=f.__path AND c.__start<f.__start AND c.__end>=f.__end ORDER BY c.__start)),'')||f.name AS symbol,
 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM legacy_fns l WHERE l.__path=f.__path AND l.__start=f.__start) AS legacy,
 EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM wrapper_fns w WHERE w.__path=f.__path AND w.__start=f.__start) AS wrapper FROM fns f

stages.name: owned_calls
stages.query: SELECT c.*,(SELECT f.id FROM function_symbols f WHERE f.__path=c.__path AND f.__start<c.__start AND f.__end>=c.__end ORDER BY f.__start DESC LIMIT 1) AS fn FROM calls c

stages.name: active_functions
stages.query: SELECT * FROM (SELECT *,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY __path,symbol ORDER BY __start DESC) AS selected FROM function_symbols) WHERE selected=1

stages.name: valid_boundary
stages.query:
SELECT DISTINCT __path FROM wrapper_fns
 UNION SELECT DISTINCT f.__path FROM function_symbols f JOIN owned_calls c ON c.__path=f.__path AND c.fn=f.id AND c.callee_kind='identifier' AND c.callee IN ('run_in_legacy_execution_boundary','run_in_legacy_execution_boundary_async') JOIN fns lazy ON lazy.__path=f.__path AND lazy.name=CASE WHEN substr(f.name,-6)='_async' THEN substr(f.name,1,length(f.name)-6)||'_lazy' ELSE f.name||'_lazy' END

stages.name: raw_boundaries
stages.query: SELECT * FROM from_imports WHERE module IN ('l2050_transaction.execution_boundary','l2000_connection.execution_boundary') AND name='legacy_execution_boundary'

stages.name: eager_seeds
stages.query: SELECT f.__path,f.id AS fn,c.id AS anchor,c.__start,c.__end FROM active_functions f JOIN owned_calls c ON c.__path=f.__path AND c.fn=f.id WHERE NOT f.legacy AND c.callee_kind='attribute' AND c.callee IN ('resolve','resolve_async')

stages.name: call_candidates
stages.query:
SELECT f.__path,f.id AS caller,c.id AS anchor,c.__start,c.__end,c.callee AS candidate FROM active_functions f JOIN owned_calls c ON c.__path=f.__path AND c.fn=f.id WHERE NOT f.legacy AND c.callee NOT IN ('resolve','resolve_async','_legacy_delegate_stub','legacy_execution_boundary') AND c.callee NOT IN ('run_in_legacy_execution_boundary','run_in_legacy_execution_boundary_async')
 UNION SELECT f.__path,f.id,c.id,c.__start,c.__end,substr(f.symbol,1,length(f.symbol)-length(f.name))||c.callee FROM active_functions f JOIN owned_calls c ON c.__path=f.__path AND c.fn=f.id WHERE NOT f.legacy AND c.callee_kind='attribute' AND c.callee NOT IN ('resolve','resolve_async') AND c.object_text IN ('self','cls') AND instr(f.symbol,'.')>0

stages.name: resolved_calls
stages.query: SELECT c.__path,c.caller,c.anchor,c.__start,c.__end,min(f.id) AS callee FROM call_candidates c JOIN active_functions f ON f.__path=c.__path AND (f.name=c.candidate OR f.symbol=c.candidate) GROUP BY c.__path,c.caller,c.anchor,c.__start,c.__end,c.candidate HAVING count(*)=1 AND min(f.id)!=c.caller

stages.name: eager_reach
stages.query: WITH RECURSIVE reaches(__path,fn) AS (SELECT __path,fn FROM eager_seeds UNION SELECT r.__path,c.caller FROM reaches r JOIN resolved_calls c ON c.__path=r.__path AND c.callee=r.fn JOIN active_functions f ON f.__path=c.__path AND f.id=c.caller WHERE NOT f.legacy) SELECT * FROM reaches

stages.name: eager_anchors
stages.query:
SELECT __path,fn,anchor,__start,__end FROM (
 SELECT e.__path,e.fn,e.anchor,e.__start,e.__end,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY e.__path,e.fn ORDER BY e.__start,e.__end DESC) AS selected FROM eager_seeds e) WHERE selected=1
 UNION SELECT __path,fn,anchor,__start,__end FROM (
 SELECT c.__path,c.caller AS fn,c.anchor,c.__start,c.__end,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY c.__path,c.caller ORDER BY c.__start,c.__end DESC) AS selected FROM resolved_calls c JOIN eager_reach r ON r.__path=c.__path AND r.fn=c.callee WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM eager_seeds s WHERE s.__path=c.__path AND s.fn=c.caller)) WHERE selected=1
